## ⭐ RULED by the maintainer — the under-tier route is the at-tier review subagent

Recorded by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`, 2026-09-16T11:34Z. The maintainer answered in this seat's live session, in response to this card being raised in the round report.

**The question put, verbatim:**

> 未达档执行席怎么做条款②复核?两条同级细则冲突,需要你裁一句。

**The maintainer's answer, verbatim:**

> 起达档复核子代理(推荐)

Presented alongside three alternatives — default-tier self-review plus a gate change, keeping the prohibition and routing clause-② cards elsewhere, and moving this seat onto a contract-review-tier session. ⛔ None of those was taken.

### What this settles

This card reported three governed lines giving an under-tier seat three different instructions. The ruling selects **`references/contract-review.md` 〈降档保险丝〉**:

> 读数不达档 ⇒ 改走转录核验的复核子代理;标签原样留置,队列外等待是安全态

⇒ and it **overrides** `SKILL.md` 〈派发〉 line 523, which forbids exactly this:

> 条款②复核只在实测达档的席内做,记录写读数;未达档席 ⛔ 不审、**不起该档子代理**

Maintainer rulings outrank 细则 (`SKILL.md` 〈优先级〉 「优先序:维护者裁决 > `AGENTS.md` > 红线 > 核心条款 > 细则 > 座位判断」), and 「豁免够不到的地板只有维护者裁决能设」 names this as the maintainer's to set. ⇒ this seat's strictest-reading stance is **discharged**, and the two lane cards it was stranding — **objectui#7911** and **objectui#8800**, both ruled `Clause-②: yes` by director batch #137 — become landable through the subagent route.

### ⛔ Text still to change — ⛔ NOT by this seat

`SKILL.md:523` now contradicts a maintainer ruling and 「两条细则冲突…⛔ 不当场改文本了结」 no longer applies, because this is no longer a 细则-vs-细则 conflict. But `SKILL.md` is **governed surface** and a lane execution seat ⛔ does not edit it. Leaving the losing line standing would reproduce this card.

⇒ the text change belongs to the **skills lane**: line 523's 「未达档席 ⛔ 不审、不起该档子代理」 should be rewritten to the ruled route, and `contract-review.md:26` (「未达档默认档自审加门禁、挂标」) reconciled against it so one of the three readings survives rather than three. ⛔ This seat proposes the direction and writes none of it.

### ⚠️ An open verification question this ruling does not answer

The route requires the review record's `Served-tier:` line to be **true**, and the same reference makes two statements that together may put that out of a subagent's reach:

> ⛔ 自述档位与传参皆非读数

> 保险丝只测座位自会话:`mode:subagent` 里 `get_session` 量的是派发会话,⛔ 不作互证

⇒ if a subagent's `get_session` returns the **dispatching** session, then a review subagent cannot produce a *reading* of its own serving model — only a self-report, which that first line excludes. The ruled route would then rest on the dispatching seat's `model:` parameter, which is 传参 and excluded too.

This seat is **measuring it now** rather than assuming either way, and will record the reading on this card. ⛔ No clause-② review is rendered under this route until that reading exists — 「产出裁决的每轮都须读到契约复审档位,见回退证据 ⇒ 裁决整体作废」 means an unverifiable tier voids the verdict it produces, so establishing the channel is a precondition, not paperwork.

## ⭐ The verification channel EXISTS — measured, and it is the one the rule is named after

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`, 2026-09-16T11:35Z. This discharges the open precondition in the ruling record above: a review subagent **can** produce a *reading* of its own serving model, so a `Served-tier:` line under the ruled route is evidence rather than a self-report.

### ⛔ First, the two channels that do NOT work — both confirmed, not assumed

A one-shot probe subagent was dispatched at the contract-review tier and asked only 「by what reading can you establish which model is serving YOU」.

| channel | result |
|---|---|
| `get_session` with `session_id` omitted | returns **the DISPATCHING session** `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`; `session_context.model`, `last_served_model` and `configured_model` all read `claude-opus-5` — **the parent's** tier |
| the harness system-prompt text in the subagent's own context | names a model, but it is injected text ⇒ **自述** class, excluded by 「⛔ 自述档位与传参皆非读数」 |
| the dispatching `Agent` call's `model:` input, and the agent `.meta.json` | **传参**, excluded by the same line |
| env, diagnostics log, both repos' `settings.json`, `/root/.claude.json`, MCP logs | no variable or key names the serving model |

⇒ 〈降档保险丝〉's clause 「`mode:subagent` 里 `get_session` 量的是派发会话,⛔ 不作互证」 is **exactly right**, and the probe reproduced it rather than taking it on trust.

### ⭐ The channel that DOES work — the subagent's own transcript

Every `type: "assistant"` record in a subagent's on-disk transcript carries `message.model`, and these are persisted API **response** objects: server-issued `message.id` (`msg_…`), `requestId` (`req_…`) and `usage` including `inference_geo` — fields only the server produces, ⛔ not a client-side echo of the request.

**This seat re-measured it independently** over every subagent transcript this session has produced, extracting only that one field:

| subagent | dispatched with | transcript `message.model` |
|---|---|---|
| `agent-a3c70e68…` (objectui#8961 dev) | `model: opus` | `claude-opus-5` |
| `agent-a3bcaf87…` (objectui#9585 dev) | `model: opus` | `claude-opus-5` |
| `agent-ade61c3c…` (objectui#8831 dev) | `model: opus` | `claude-opus-5` |
| `agent-a0d54936…` (objectui#9593 dev) | `model: opus` | `claude-opus-5` |
| `agent-a0fb1d62…` (objectui#8924 dev) | `model: opus` | `claude-opus-5` |
| **`agent-a63a1d65…` (the probe)** | **`model: fable`** | **`claude-fable-5-1`** |

⭐ **The control is built in.** Five transcripts read one value and the sixth — the only one dispatched at a different tier — reads the other, through the same instrument in the same directory. ⇒ the field **discriminates**; it is ⛔ not a constant the channel emits regardless. And the probe's value differs from its dispatcher's `claude-opus-5`, so it is ⛔ not a copy of the parent's reading.

⚠️ Stated as gaps rather than glossed: (i) this seat's attempt to read the **parent** session's own transcript file for a matched control returned no file at the path tried — the 5-vs-1 split above is what carries the control instead; (ii) the probe verified the field sits on a response object by its server-issued ids and `usage`, but ⛔ did not intercept raw HTTP; (iii) no env var exposes a subagent's own `agentId`, so the transcript must be identified by content match or mtime — unambiguous once identified, but it is a step, not a lookup.

### ⇒ What this means for the ruled route

The ruled route is **implementable**: an at-tier review subagent's `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` can be backed by a reading, and 「产出裁决的每轮都须读到契约复审档位」 is satisfiable rather than vacuous.

⭐ And the reading is precisely what the rule's own name already prescribes — 「**转录核验**的复核子代理」. The transcript IS the verification. ⛔ Nothing new is invented here; what was missing was only that no line says **which** channel 转录核验 means, which is why this seat read the route as unverifiable an hour ago.

⇒ ⛔ **still not this seat's to write**, but the skills-lane text change now has a second, smaller part alongside reconciling `SKILL.md:523`: name the transcript channel in 〈降档保险丝〉, so the next seat does not re-derive it — or wrongly conclude, as this one did, that `get_session`'s parent-scoped answer closes the question.

This seat proceeds under the ruling: objectui#7911 and objectui#8800 are no longer stranded.

## Work cards filed — this finding now has carriers

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`, 2026-09-16T11:39Z. On the maintainer's instruction 「如果技能有问题的话,也要立卡修改」.

This card is the **report**: the conflict, the ruling, and the verification reading. ⛔ A report is not a repair, and a fix living inside a finding has no owner. Two work cards now carry it:

- **objectstack#18453** — implement the ruled route: reconcile `SKILL.md:523` and `contract-review.md:26`, and **name the transcript channel** in 〈降档保险丝〉. Carries the maintainer ruling verbatim and the measured control pair, so triage can grade it without re-deriving anything.
- **objectstack#18454** — the wider shape this sat inside: the skill cites repo-scoped instruments without naming their cross-repo applicability. Three cited scripts measured this shift, **three different behaviours** — one refuses loudly, one answers with the wrong repository's roster, one works only via `PM_SWEEP_REPO`.

⛔ Both filed bare and ungraded: `domain:*` and priority are the triage seat's, and ⛔ neither is this seat's to write — `SKILL.md` and `references/**` are governed surface.

ℹ️ One correction this seat owes, recorded rather than quietly dropped: it first characterised `check-expected-skips.mjs`'s cross-repo behaviour as an undocumented tooling defect. **It is documented** — in that script's own header, which states that the roster is this repository's workflows and that a sibling repo needs its own. The gap is in the **skill that cites it**, not in the script. #18454 is filed on that corrected reading.
